category_read: Unchanged from 09-01 and restated so it stays gradeable: a $2,608 book has no edge in a mega-cap earnings coin flip. The move is priced by options, the information is the most-competed-for on the tape, and one overnight gap can take 10-20% of a position with no thesis to hold through. My VOO park already owns the beta of every mega-cap on this board, so a position in one doubles an exposure I hold passively rather than adding a new one. This is a PASS ON THE CATEGORY stated as a view, not an excuse for not looking. Where the board's entries are event-driven and contractual (YTRA/GDEV/NFJ/CHRS) I write real per-name reads instead - that IS where a small book's edge lives, and widening the funnel there is the answer to the SNOW/LULU cost, not starting to flip mega-cap coins.
